data_storage: Local Store managed folder / memos / data
risk_notes: Creates a Docker container named local-store-memos.
Publishes port 5230 on this computer's loopback interface only.
Stores the SQLite database and uploaded assets in the Local Store app directory.
Complete Memos setup and review its access settings before storing private notes.
compose:
services:
  memos:
    image: neosmemo/memos:0.30.0@sha256:71a5b4738d1bed96e92112004054f0888e92791b64eb78afd79077c96e6f9327
    container_name: local-store-memos
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:5230:5230"
    environment:
      MEMOS_PORT: "5230"
      MEMOS_DRIVER: sqlite
    volumes:
      - ./data:/var/opt/memos
    mem_limit: 268435456
    cpus: "2.000"
    pids_limit: 256

resource_limits.reason: Managed-engine launch task measured 15917383 bytes at peak for this service. The 256 MiB development ceiling allows headroom and bounds runaway work; larger workloads require separate sizing.
